source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of scalability and elasticity (PDF 156).

items: Scalability: zaroorat par wasail barhana. Eid ya 14 August ki sale mein traffic barhne par online store servers barha sakta hai ta ke site sust ya band na ho.
Elasticity: maujooda talab ke mutabiq wasail khud badalna. Traffic barhne par cloud servers barhata aur sale ke baad kam karta hai, to ghair zaroori wasail ki qeemat nahi deni parti.

blocks.prompt: Scalability aur elasticity mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: Scalability zaroorat par wasail barhane ki salahiyat hai; elasticity talab badalne par unhein khud barhati aur ghatati hai.

items: Scalability: urooj ke liye wasail barhana. Elasticity: talab ke saath khud-kaar kami beshi.
